description: Rules of the dev mode (--mode=dev): a copy of a live shop must not talk to the live world. Each rule can be switched off with --dev-skip=ID; more rules can be added with --dev-rules=FILE (same format, a rule with a known id replaces the built-in one). See docs/PHASE1.md 3.9.

rules.title: Send no mail to real recipients
rules.description: With a mail catcher (--mail-catcher=HOST:PORT) the shop sends through it over SMTP; without one it does not send at all.

rules.title: Cut the live payment connections
rules.description: PayPal is switched to sandbox without any live credential; PrestaShop Checkout (which pays through the live PayPal account) is deactivated.

rules.title: Detach the shop from PrestaShop Account and its cloud services
rules.description: The keys, tokens and shop proof of PrestaShop Account (and its Firebase login) identify the live shop in PrestaShop's cloud; a copy that keeps them acts on behalf of the live shop.

rules.title: Stop advertising and analytics tracking
rules.description: Visits and orders on the dev copy must not show up in the live Google Analytics, Google Ads or Facebook accounts.

rules.title: Keep search engines out
rules.description: robots.txt forbids everything and every response carries X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow (a block in .htaccess outside PrestaShop's own markers, so it survives a regeneration).
